Question: A man spends $5 per week on the lottery every week for 17 years. On average he wins the $200 prize once every 25 weeks. After 17 years, how much is he up/down?
Answer: 17 years = 884 weeks. $5 per week = $4,420 One win ever 25 weeks = 35.36 wins, we’ll round up to 36 wins. At $200 per win that gives him $7,720 from his wins. Just so you know, my old job would go in on a twice weekly drawing. As luck would have it, they actually kicked in $5 twice a week or $10 a week. I asked them how much they usually won and they told me that they had a payout a few years back for around $1,700 that was split 5 ways. So $10 a week is $520 a year and $1,700 divided by f is $350. And keep in mind, that was their only payout in around 6 years of doing that.
